name: io.github.matharrismma/narrow-highway
title: Narrow Highway — verification engine
description: A deterministic verification engine for AI agents. Hand it a claim and it returns a verdict, the worked trail, and a permanent, re-checkable receipt (content-addressed seal) — deterministic math and rules, no model in the loop. Stops an agent's answers from being taken on faith: every one can carry proof. Free, one URL, no key.

_notes.witness_surface: https://narrowhighway.org/mcp adds Scripture tools (passage reading, original-language word studies, cross-references).
_notes.provable: Every verdict returns {content_hash, cite_url}; the seal is re-fetchable at https://narrowhighway.com/s/<content_hash> and re-checkable with a ~60-line stdlib verifier (docs/SEAL_SPEC.md, tools/verify_seal.py). Re-check without trusting us.
